key_insight: A frozen physics foundation model pretrained for PDE forecasting can be repurposed into a stronger closed-loop fluid-control policy than a standard MLP using lightweight RL heads.
engineering_relevance: This suggests pretraining on general flow dynamics could reduce data and improve controller performance for practical active-flow control systems.
method: Freeze a PDE-forecasting physics foundation model and attach small Gaussian actor/critic heads.
Train the policy with proximal policy optimization (PPO) for closed-loop control.
Compare against an MLP policy under the same PPO setup on Kolmogorov-flow benchmarks.
evidence_signal: Evaluated in HydroGym’s 2D Kolmogorov-flow environment using vorticity at 64×64 and 128×128 resolutions for Re=100 and Re=200, where the PFM controller achieved higher reward with smaller action magnitudes than the MLP baseline.
watch_item: Results are limited to a specific 2D benchmark and frozen-representation setup, so transfer to more complex flows or real-world actuation remains unverified.
paper_title: Physics Foundation Models for Efficient Control of Fluid Flows
